KAFKA-PR-23865.title: MINOR: Acquire RefreshingHttpsJwks lock before entering try block

records.title: PR #23865: MINOR: Acquire RefreshingHttpsJwks lock before entering try block
records.author: egyedt
records.excerpt: The lock() calls in RefreshingHttpsJwks were made inside the try block. If lock() threw, the finally block would call unlock() on a lock that was never acquired, throwing IllegalMonitorStateException and masking the original error. Move lock() before try at all four sites, following the standard java.util.concurrent.locks idiom.
